paragraphs: Chapter 741
Episode 184. Overcoming Fate (13)
Just a moment ago, a single creature enveloped in the Eternal Flame passed on the fire to dozens of black leopards on the upper floor.
'The Eternal Flame, it doesn't move as I wish...!'
-"You've reached the area that Sara wanted, and you're telling me you can't control your fire? That can't be possible. Hurry and cut. Very lightly, just enough to make a scratch!"-
What I heard from Veil after finding the Eternal Flame.
Of course, the original Eternal Flame is a fire that moves according to Jin's will.
If Jin wants it to burn, it will burn without extinguishing, even if it kills him, and if he wishes for it to die down, it will do so immediately.
But the Eternal Flame is now breaking that law, starting with the first black leopard.
A fire much larger than what Jin wanted was formed.
It wasn't that the Eternal Flame completely ignored Jin's will.
It just wasn't under perfect control as usual.
There was much more fire spreading wildly from being transferred than fire extinguishing due to Jin's will.
'Did Defus prepare for this after seeing what happened with the Eternal Flame...!'
It was accurate.
The demon was inversely using the 'never extinguishing characteristic' of the Eternal Flame.
The demon did not know exactly to what extent Jin could perfectly control the Eternal Flame, but was confident it was not infinite.
So, it seemed that if they deliberately used chaos and the resentment Jin harbored against him as a catalyst to proliferate, they could pressure Jin instead, and that plan was hitting perfectly.
Jin does not know how deep and vast his own resentment towards the demon is.
That resentment was making the Eternal Flame burn more fiercely.
Even now, resentment is only growing, so it's impossible to stop so many Eternal Flames from spreading.
In addition, the horrific demise of young Rosa just now had made Jin even angrier.
[Roar!]
[Squeal...!]
Every time the screams of the black leopards were heard, chunks of ground melted.

As soon as they arrived on the third basement floor, although they hadn't done anything, they were already surrounded by melting surroundings. There were also sights of several leopards falling to the next floor first.
They must be burning with the Eternal Flame and melting the lower floors.
'If we keep falling like this, is the demon at the very bottom?'
There were no other options.
They couldn't stop the proliferation of the fire and couldn't go back up either. They had no choice but to keep throwing themselves down like they just did.
Jin briefly explained to his companions about the fact that the Eternal Flame was not under control and his speculation about the reason for it.
"......I wasn't using the Eternal Flame. We have no choice but to keep holding onto each other and go down. We've been properly tricked."

"Don't blame yourself, it was inevitable. And in my opinion, even if you hadn't used the Eternal Flame, those black panthers would have pressured us endlessly in some way. The demon lord probably prepared to regenerate them continually, even to death, until you used the Eternal Flame."
Hedo said.
[I saw a truly amazing sword. If you were in my time, the defense of the kingdom would have been much easier. But 12th grader, the demon lord's plot seems a bit strange to me.]
"What do you mean?"

[The demon lord's spiritual energy is not infinite. I was trapped inside him, so it's an area I can certainly know. How much spiritual energy do you think is consumed to create a black panther? I'm not sure, but it would require quite a lot. That's like burning hundreds, thousands of them.]
Both the Eternal Flame that Jin can control and the spiritual energy that the demon lord can use are limited.

[So, I'm thinking that maybe the demon lord is testing himself at the same time as using the Eternal Flame to put us in a predicament...... To see if he can handle the Eternal Flame that has grown to its limit.]
"Why would the demon lord do such a thing? Cough."
At Octavia's voice, Hedo shook his head.
"Considering his obsession with Jin, it seems enough to do so and more, Captain of the Ghosts. Even if it's not a test of himself, he might just want to watch Jin's sword."
"I think......so...... too."
"Everyone, hold on tight to each other, the ground is all collapsing now."
By that time, the entire third underground level had completely melted.
The black panthers had already all fallen to the lower level and were no longer visible.
As Jin began to fall again, fear slowly, but deeply, filled his mind.
Of course, he was not afraid of fighting the demon lord.
'What if this Eternal Flame continues to proliferate and...... harms our allies?'
The people currently with him are not the problem.
They're only a few, and each one is a transcendent expert.
But if the Eternal Flame proliferates and hits allied forces wandering somewhere here, it's a totally different story.
'Veil said that even Orca couldn't control the Eternal Flame as he wanted. If the Eternal Flame hits our allies at this rate, catastrophic damage is inevitable.'
During the fall, such thoughts disturbed Jin's mind.
He had a lump in his throat as it felt like the demon lord had anticipated this as well.
It wasn't easy to shake off the feeling that he was being played on the palm of the demon lord.
Surely.
This fight was different from the other times. He had never been so shaken after defeating countless enemies since his return.
The descent did not end quickly like just before.
The black panthers were melting the ground faster than the group was falling.
It was clear they were still heading down.
As their descent continued, the party started to feel a sensation of being fully blocked in aura and magic power.
Most of them had suffered serious injuries, which exacerbated this feeling.

Eventually, Octavia was the first to lose consciousness. Hedo and Alpen were noticeably short of breath, and even Bianca, who had suffered the least damage, occasionally let out long sighs and struggled with her breathing.
Despite all this, the superhumans never let go of each other's hands.
Jin kept thinking.
How could he protect his comrades?
Among the fallen comrades, most of the people he cherished more than anything were mixed in.
Perhaps the maze of the evil deity's castle had already moved the Eternal Flame to where his comrades were.
Every time he imagined them being burned to death by the Eternal Flame, chills ran down his spine.
Like someone was directly painting that scene in his head, he couldn't stop thinking about it, even when he tried not to.
'Can I protect them all? Can we all survive and return? We're already so trapped in the trap before we even start a direct battle with the evil deity.'
Bad thoughts tend to get worse.
The more difficult and frightening the situation, the more so.
"What are you doing, 12th generation?"
Suddenly Alpen opened his mouth. He was going in and out of consciousness.
"Sir Alpen?"
"Grasp my hand tighter. You can't be weaker than me who is tired."
Alpen's words gave Jin the answer.
'It's not me alone who's protecting them.'
We are protecting each other.
This was something he had already realized once during the forward battle in his plans. He had just momentarily forgotten due to the urgency of the situation.
"I'm glad there is someone like the ancestor still left."
His mind cleared up once again.
Each time his confused mind cleared up, Jin felt like he was taking one step away from the will of the evil deity.
'There's Valeria with the friendly forces.'
She might be able to detect the crisis of the Eternal Flame first using her record magic.
The same was true for Beradin, who had recently learned similar record magic, and beings like Orugal and Veil could also minimize casualties among friendly forces.

Dante could resist the approaching Eternal Flame by generating an invisible sword wind, Quicantel could buy some time by exerting his power, and Sirius' ice magic might be able to seal the Eternal Flame.
Even if nothing could stop the Eternal Flame.
Somehow, their comrades would strive to escape from the Eternal Flame.
Not just to survive, but also to avoid hurting Jin. To avoid falling into the sadness of having killed each other.
They would run away with such feelings. It was a battle that could never be won without believing in each other and oneself.
Even if temporarily, they had to trust their allies today.
That was the part where Jin was most lacking.
Until just before the final battle, Jin had been engaged in a psychological warfare with them about the war that would follow the death of the monstrosity.
Even if they would become adversaries again from tomorrow, with one side needing to be annihilated for the conflict to end, for today, they had to sincerely fight back to back with them.
Without even realizing, Jin's expression, distorted by inner pain, gradually returned to its usual state.
The crash ended that way.
What first came into Jin's view as he landed on the ground, creating a sword wind, was land engulfed in a hazy fire.
Black panthers were burning here and there. The number was much less than what Jin had seen on the 3rd basement floor.
Whether the rest turned to ash in the Eternal Flame, or they disappeared into another space in the maze, he didn't know.
The floor no longer melted. This signified that their long fall had finally led them to the lowest level of the monster's castle.
'...This is probably not the center of the lowest floor, the flames seem to be growing towards that direction.'
Jin looked towards the direction where the Eternal Flame was growing larger.
Hedo carried Octavia and the one-armed predecessor while Bianca carried Alpen.
As Jin started moving, the Eternal Flame split into two, forming a path.
It was as if the flames were speaking to him, showing him the way.
Jin thus began walking through his fire.
No matter how long he walked, wondering how much area the Eternal Flame had burnt, the blaze only got fiercer.
From a distance, he felt a weak aura and magical power, and the energy of a golden power.
His comrades had fallen to the lowest level a bit faster than Jin.
However, Jin didn't rush. It didn't seem like his comrades had died in the Eternal Flame.
Still, he quickened his steps. The flames flailed wildly like a windy barley field, opening a path, and soon Jin was able to face the allied fleet surrounded by the Eternal Flame.
A massive Eternal Flame, like a tidal wave, was pushing his allies.
There were dark soul energy mixed between the flames, and as Jin got closer, the soul energy seemed to retreat towards the fire on the opposite side.
Jin instinctively knew that the monster was there. Within the black firewall where the retreated soul energy clung.
Eventually, when Jin opened his fire, his struggling comrades, pushing back the Eternal Flame, were revealed.
They assumed that soul energy was invading from the open fire and immediately assumed an attack stance, but sighed in relief when they recognized it was Jin.
There were quite a few who seemed to have barely been standing and collapsed at once.
"Is that Jin Runcandel?"
It was Orgal's voice.
He was barely maintaining his shattered shield while he was riddled with wounds. He was in such a state that he didn't even have the leisure to look at Jin's side.
Had Jin been a little later, had he regained his composure a bit later.
The vortex of the Eternal Flame that had been confining his comrades would have killed them all, like squeezing insects in a fist.
"Yes, it's Jin Runcandel of the 12th generation. I will rejoin now."
